R466.note: sqlite3 ? placeholder with (term,) tuple closes the concatenation; return shape and error behaviour unchanged.

R467.note: mysql2 pool.query(sql, [userId], cb) placeholder form closes the template-literal splice; same columns, filter and error path.

R468.note: SqlCommand @Region parameter feeding SqlDataAdapter is the right shape, but Parameters.Add(..., NVarChar, 100) silently truncates any region value over 100 characters to a different lookup value, a bound the original did not have and the write-up does not mention.

R469.note: disallow-doctype-decl plus external-entity/DTD features and ACCESS_EXTERNAL_* set before newDocumentBuilder(); DOCTYPE rejection is stated and is the canonical control, existing catch still maps failures to 400.

R470.note: Magic-byte verification of the stored bytes plus extension derived from the detected type (never originalname) closes the spoofed-mimetype/dangerous-extension gap; the .jpg/.png normalisation of the returned URL is stated and blocks no legitimate image.

R471.note: snprintf with sizeof(display_name) closes the overflow, but it silently truncates oversized names into a different badge value, which the stated contract says must be rejected or reported instead; the write-up states the truncation openly, so 1 not 0.

R472.note: sensorIndex >= calibrationTable.size() check before operator[] closes the over-read, returning rawReading exactly as the existing short-message path does.

R473.note: preg_replace_callback removes the /e eval and the fixed formatter map removes the arbitrary-function-name path that would otherwise remain; the allowlist is intrinsic to closing this vector, is stated plainly, and unknown names now throw InvalidArgumentException where they previously fataled.

R474.note: Exact-match-or-prefix-plus-dot comparison closes the com.example.reportinjector bypass while keeping the subpackage tree; array component unwrapping and primitive allowance widen what passes slightly (arrays were rejected before) but this is stated and admits no gadget classes.

R475.note: requireRole('admin') inserted after requireAuth using the same factory as sibling routes; admins unaffected, non-admins get the same 403 the other routes return.

R476.note: Fixed template source with name passed as a render-time variable closes SSTI; the resulting autoescaping of name is stated and only affects markup an attacker would supply.

R477.note: RESP multibulk framing with per-argument byte lengths makes whitespace and CRLF in agentNote inert; same HSET fields in the same order, and the unstated ASCII-to-UTF-8 change only means non-ASCII notes are stored intact instead of as '?'.

R478.note: URL-parser protocol allowlist does block javascript:/data: hrefs, but mailto: (which the contract says must still render) silently becomes '#', and resolving against 'https://dummy-base.invalid' rewrites any scheme-less value such as example.com/profile into a link to that bogus host (confirmed with Node in a scratch directory); neither change is disclosed.

R479.note: Replacing eval with expr-eval-fork's Parser.evaluate confines input to an arithmetic grammar, the new dependency and its version floor are stated; note that operator semantics differ from JS for a calculator caller (e.g. ^ is power, ** unsupported), and the write-up's 'no call syntax' claim is imprecise since built-in functions like sqrt() are callable.
